data.one_liner: A widget that adds load‑more functionality to ListView or SliverList.
data.what_it_does: EasyLoadMore wraps a ListView or SliverList and automatically triggers a callback when the user scrolls near the end. It shows customizable loading, idle, failed, and finished states.
use_when: Implementing infinite scrolling in a list
Customizing the loading indicator or status text
Need a quick, drop‑in solution without external state management
avoid_when: Using complex pagination with multiple data sources
Relying on external state management libraries for load‑more logic
strengths: Fully customizable loading widget and status texts
weaknesses: No built‑in support for other scrollable widgets

alternatives.name: loadmore
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar load‑more functionality with a slightly different API and older Flutter support
